resources.string: Quick settings for this app
Pause until I leave this app
The last selection was temporarily paused
Close this wheel
Pause this app for 10 minutes
Disable automatic popups in this app
Back to the wheel
Automatic popups in this app are temporarily paused
Resume automatic popups in this app
Keep the wheel after copying
Continue with search or another action after copying. This selection is kept for up to 30 seconds and cleared on closing, leaving, or locking the screen. The clipboard is not read again.
Search action names or URLs
No matching actions
Clear the search before dragging to reorder
Duplicate as a new action
%1$s copy
Example text for testing
Preview test link
Open test URL
Automatic entry is off
Enable automatic selection or menu compatibility under Triggers. Manual text-menu, share and clipboard entries remain available.
Accessibility authorization is needed
ActionHalo is not enabled in system accessibility settings. Authorize it, then select text in another app.
Authorized, but the service is disconnected
Check background running and battery restrictions. Text-menu, share and copied-text entries remain available while recovering.
Automatic entry is paused
This pause expires automatically, or you can resume now. Existing app rules are preserved.
Enable at least one action before testing the wheel.
Waiting to resume
The request is waiting for window focus and resumes when focus returns. If it expires, select text and choose an action again.
Select the text again
The original selection, copy interval or source window has changed. Select again and choose an action to avoid using an older clipboard.
The action did not complete
Check the URL template and opening preference. If the chosen app is unavailable, try the web or default option.
The last wheel or action worked
No issue currently needs attention. If only one app fails to show the wheel, check its app rules or menu compatibility.
The last selection was blocked by app rules
This is controlled by app rules. Restore automatic entry under Apps and rules; manual text-menu and share entries remain available.
A visit pause ends when you leave the app; a timed pause expires automatically. You can also resume on this app’s rules page.
The initial selection is ready
The initial selection stays quiet. Adjust the selection handles and release to open the wheel directly, or open ActionHalo from the Android text selection menu.
This selection cannot be read
Password and protected areas are not processed. Try an ordinary text area.
The source did not expose a readable selection
Try menu compatibility, or use ActionHalo manually from the system text menu or share entry.
The wheel window could not be shown
Check the service connection and background settings, then test the sample wheel.
The sample wheel worked
This confirms the window can be shown. Select text in another app to check its support.
No usable selection received yet
Select text in another app. Where selection changes are exposed, adjust and release to open the wheel. Menu-only apps show it directly when a supported Copy menu is recognized.
No actions are available for this app
Check this app’s action list and the app scope of its actions.
